LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.0.label: 鼬族厌恶(-2)
LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.0.description: 难道我要永远被这些可怕的家伙饲养吗？真恶心……不管用什么方法，我都要逃出去！
LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.1.label: 鼬族厌恶(-1)
LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.1.description: 那次真是太屈辱了……我得想办法离开这里……
LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.2.label: 鼬族症候群(+5)
LanguageData.Weazel_SyndromeMood.stages.2.description: 现在这里更像家了。还能糟到哪去呢？
